text:
Ruth: Dropping a new pocket brief draft aimed at governance and platform leads. Focus: data residency, SLA buckets, and quick deploy-mode guidance (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need a 30s exec hook, a 3-line decision flow, a micro-benchmark panel, and a one-line procurement note. Link: https://docs.google.com/internal-governance-brief (internal)
Ben: Nice. For the decision flow can we phrase choices as signals: 1) data residency/regulation, 2) predictable throughput commitments, 3) top-tier latency SLAs. One short sentence per signal.
Sofia: Add a one-line "how we fail gracefully" blurb that we can show in the webinar: automatic fallback to an alternative pool + model-variant compatibility check. Avoid technical jargon.
Akash: Ops asked for a compact canary config for the slide. Make it tiny and human-friendly. Example to paste:```yaml
canary:
  rollout: 10%
  monitor: 20m
  fallback: true
```
clare: For compliance copy: call out SOC2, KMS with customer-managed keys, optional HSM, audit logs with retention choices. Phrase as buyer-facing bullets, not legal text.
Ruth: Added a 3-row micro-table (Latency | Predictability | Control) with one-phrase cells and a one-sentence recommendation per mode. Also added a 4-question sales qual checklist.
Ben: Benchmarks: can someone include two short workload callouts? e.g., pilot e-comm (10k msgs/day) and regulated finance (50k msgs/day) with p95 short-chat latencies and a headline $/1k-token delta per mode. One line each.
Sofia: I'll compress the numbers into a single-line micro-panel and include a short note: "actual costs depend on sequence lengths and batching".
Akash: Ops wants an inbound lead-tagging CSV template so SalesOps can auto-route leads by governance needs. Suggested headers: email,company,deploy_interest,data_residency,monthly_token_estimate. I'll attach mapping.
clare: Tone tweak: replace any absolute "guarantee" language with "target SLA" or "service objective". Add escalation path for enterprise: "P1 -> 1hr target response; account escalation to Solutions".
Ruth: For the webinar landing blurb I want two variants: long (email) and short (registration). Long: 3 bullets; short: 2 bullets. Keep them punchy.
Ben: Also add a 2-line speaker opener for the host that mentions governance tradeoffs and a customer vignette about an outage where fallback saved the day. Keep it conversational.
Sofia: I'll draft the 30s host script and a 3-slide arc: 1) governance problem, 2) Redwood runtime + routing, 3) live failover + benchmarks.
Akash: For the canary snippet on the slide use the tiny YAML above. Ops will also provide a mock timeline graphic showing a region failover across 5 minutes.
clare: Compliance review: include a single sentence about customer-managed key rotation and give a link to the compliance packet.
Ruth: CTA options: "Schedule a governance demo" or "Request a Dedicated trial". Also add a one-line procurement ballpark: "Dedicated: ~+30-50% vs Hosted; Private: contact sales" so procurement has a kernel for RFPs.
Ben: I'll prepare the tag CSV and a short SalesOps handoff doc by Thu noon.
Sofia: I'll finalize host script and the micro-bench panel by Thu 3pm.
Akash: Ops will deliver the mock failover chart and canary snippet PNG by Thu 5pm.
clare: I'll finish compliance sign-off and remove any legalese by Thu 6pm.
Ruth: Need final PDF for webinar promo Friday 08:00. Who can lock copy by Thu EOD?
Ben: I'll lock the tags and handoff doc by Thu EOD.
Sofia: I'll lock copy by Thu EOD and post final PDF here Fri AM.
deploy-bot: Note: linked doc updated 7 minutes ago by Ruth
Ruth: Thanks team 680. Will merge comments and post the final one-pager tomorrow morning.
